name: cloudhost247-platform
description: CloudHost247 full-stack monolith. Zero-framework Node.js http platform + Vanilla JS public site + React Vite SPA + PWA + Capacitor native apps.
comment: pg is the ONLY dependency and is optional at runtime: when DATABASE_URL is unset the platform uses the zero-dependency JSON file store in src/store/json-store.js. Every other capability (http, routing, validation, crypto, passwords, JWT, TOTP, WebAuthn, QR, PNG, YAML, logging, static files, multipart, rate limiting) is implemented on Node core modules only.
